name: Pointerless Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph (PSVDAG)
aliases: Pointerless Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph
definition: The PSVDAG structure is defined by Backus-Naur Form (BNF) where a PSVDAG consists of a header NODE. A NODE is either an Inner Node (INODE) or a Leaf Node (LNODE).
summary: PSVDAG is a memory-efficient 3D voxel structure that replaces fixed pointers with variable-length binary labels and callers to achieve high compression for archiving and streaming.
